changelog:
- Initial release of markitdown-skill.
- Convert documents and web pages (PDF, Word, PPT, Excel, images/OCR, audio, HTML, YouTube, URLs) to Markdown using Microsoft's MarkItDown CLI.
- Proactively converts files and links before reading, summarizing, analyzing, or depositing content to knowledge base, cutting token costs by extracting semantic content first.
- Includes guidance on token-saving workflow, batch conversion, and utility scripts (batch_convert.py, token_saver.py).
- Provides both English and Chinese documentation and setup instructions.
summary: Convert documents AND web pages to Markdown with Microsoft's MarkItDown CLI (`markitdown`). Supports PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, images (OCR), audio/video transcription, HTML, YouTube, and direct URLs / web links. Proactively use whenever a user provides a file OR a webpage link / URL / 网址 / 链接 and asks to read, analyze, summarize, extract, translate, or Q&A about it, or to deposit (沉淀) its content into a knowledge base. ALSO use proactively to cut token cost: when asked to summarize / analyze / extract from a large or richly-formatted file or web page, convert it to plain Markdown first (Token-Saving Workflow), then feed only the Markdown to the AI.
